name: 纪实电影风
look_en: candid documentary film look, an unposed moment caught in passing, gentle film grain, slightly muted colours with deep soft shadows, shallow depth of field, like a still from a quiet independent film
avoid: 摆拍感；过度调色成青橙

name: 北欧家居风
look_en: Scandinavian home: light oak, white and warm grey walls, linen and wool textures, one or two green plants, uncluttered rooms, soft clean daylight

name: 奶油风
look_en: cream-style interior: warm off-white, beige and soft caramel tones, rounded furniture, boucle and plush textures, low contrast, soft diffused light

name: 萌宠海报风
look_en: playful pet poster look: the pet's face close to a wide-angle lens, a big natural expression, bright saturated sunshine, vivid sky and greenery, high energy
avoid: 产品放在广角变形区（产品要小、靠近画面中部、外形不变）；拟人表情；M1 不用
source: 从 MIAOPOP 宠物海报案例拆出（用户 2026-11-17 提供截图）

name: 温暖家庭纪实
look_en: warm family lifestyle: people and pets together on a rug at home, candid interaction caught mid-moment, looking down from a high angle, rich warm wood and deep blue textiles, cosy evening interior light
avoid: 人物看镜头；屏幕上有字
source: 从 Anker 充电器场景案例第 1 张拆出（用户 2026-11-17 提供截图）

name: 明亮通透生活风
look_en: bright airy lifestyle: a high-key white room, sheer curtains diffusing daylight, a white table or floor, genuine smiles, clean minimal props with one or two colour accents
avoid: 画面发灰；过曝把产品高光吃掉
source: 从 Anker 充电器场景案例第 5 张拆出（用户 2026-11-17 提供截图）

name: 暖阳生活风
look_en: warm sunlit lifestyle: low golden sun streaming in from one side, crisp leaf and window-frame shadows falling across warm cream walls and floors, honey oak, cream boucle and chunky knit, terracotta and burnt-orange accents, one or two green potted plants; the product large and tack-sharp in the foreground at pet eye level, the pet relaxed in the softly blurred middle ground; clean glossy commercial finish, warm but natural colour, the brushed steel stays neutral silver with warm light only on its highlight edges
avoid: 钢面被染成铜色或金色；水位窗里的水画成发亮的蓝色（1.8）；树影、窗影压在产品上或打碎产品轮廓；橙色过饱和；画面上的白底圆角信息卡（1.5 不加底框，只学照片）
source: 从用户 2026-11-20 提供的两张 PW002-S 副图拆出（安静、无线随处放）

name: 暖调家庭纪实胶片风
look_en: warm family album documentary: candid family and pet interaction without looking at camera, soft window daylight and dappled garden shade, warm oak and off-white with muted sage, fine visible film grain, gentle highlight roll-off and natural depth; keep the pet action and product readable and brushed steel neutral silver
avoid: 只用于人宠生活场景；不用作主图或功能证据图；不压黑；不过度染黄；不加明显拖影；未确认不展示产品户外使用
source: 从用户 2026-11-22 选定的门边看猫喝水样片拆出（可选）
